controles.affirmation: hook + section : "son benefice par action a chute de 58% sur un an" / "Resultat par action divise par deux et marges effondrees au dernier trimestre" (marge op 7,34%, marge nette 7,59%)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Dominion Energy determined Contracted Energy's nonregulated renewable natural gas facilities were impaired and recorded a charge of $820 million ($640 million after-tax) in impairment of assets and other charges (benefits) ... for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026" ; "Impairment of assets and other charges increased $844 million, primarily due to a charge associated with nonregulated renewable natural gas facilities ($820 million)". EPS dilue confirme : 0.37 (T2 2026) vs 0.88 (T2 2025).
controles.correction_proposee: Les chiffres sont exacts mais la cause est omise : la chute du BPA et l'effondrement des marges du T2 2026 proviennent quasi integralement d'une depreciation NON RECURRENTE de 820 M$ (640 M$ apres impot) sur les installations de gaz naturel renouvelable non reglementees, plus 195 M$ de charges CVOW non recuperables. Ajouter : "hors depreciation exceptionnelle de 820 M$, le resultat du trimestre est en progression ; le resultat net du segment principal Dominion Energy Virginia est en hausse de 22%." Sans cette precision, l'affirmation suggere une degradation operationnelle qui n'existe pas.

controles.affirmation: "L'accord de fusion interdit a Dominion Energy d'augmenter son dividende au-dela de 0,6675 $ par action et par trimestre sans l'accord de NextEra Energy"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The NextEra Energy Merger Agreement requires the Companies to obtain the consent of NextEra Energy, which consent cannot be unreasonably withheld, for certain activities, such as the payment by Dominion Energy of dividends in excess of $0.6675 per share each quarter"
controles.correction_proposee: Le mot "interdit" est plus fort que le document. Reformuler : "toute hausse du dividende au-dela de 0,6675 $ par trimestre requiert l'accord de NextEra Energy, accord qui ne peut etre refuse de maniere deraisonnable".

controles.affirmation: "en cas de rupture liee a un refus reglementaire, NextEra Energy devrait verser 4,83 Mds $ a Dominion Energy, ce qui montre que le marche lui-meme integre un risque de blocage reglementaire non negligeable"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "In other specified circumstances where the NextEra Energy Merger Agreement is terminated due to the failure of one or more specified conditions relating to or involving certain regulatory matters, NextEra Energy will be required to pay Dominion Energy a termination fee of $4.83 billion." ; le meme paragraphe precise "In comparable circumstances, NextEra Energy will be required to pay Dominion Energy a termination fee of $6.52 billion."
controles.correction_proposee: Le montant de 4,83 Mds $ est exact, mais la conclusion "le marche lui-meme integre un risque" est un non-sequitur : une indemnite de rupture est une clause negociee entre les deux parties, pas un prix de marche. De plus l'ATT omet l'indemnite de 6,52 Mds $ due par NextEra dans les circonstances comparables. Reformuler en fait brut, sans l'inference sur le marche.

controles.affirmation: "Le 15 mai 2026, Dominion Energy a signe un accord de fusion avec NextEra Energy : chaque action sera convertie en 0,8138 action NextEra plus une quote-part d'un montant fixe de 360 M$ en cash ; cloture attendue au second semestre 2027"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "at closing each outstanding share of Dominion Energy common stock ... will be converted into the right to receive (i) its pro rata share of an aggregate amount equal to $360 million in cash, without interest, and (ii) 0.8138 shares of NextEra Energy common stock" ; "which is expected in the second half of 2027" ; index des exhibits : "Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of May 15, 2026"

controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "consents and approvals required from the (i) FERC, (ii) NRC (iii) Virginia Commission, (iv) North Carolina Commission and (v) South Carolina Commission"

controles.affirmation: "si le deal n'est pas conclu d'ici novembre 2027 (extensible a aout 2028 dans certains cas), chaque partie peut le resilier"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "customary termination rights for each of Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy, including if the NextEra Energy Merger has not been consummated by November 2027, subject to extension to August 2028 in certain circumstances"

controles.affirmation: "Les dossiers deposes proposent un total de 2,25 Mds $ de credits tarifaires aux clients, dont environ 1,78 Md $ pour les seuls clients de Virginie, verses sur deux ans apres la cloture"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "proposals for an aggregate amount of $2.25 billion of customer rate credits, including approximately $1.78 billion to customers in Virginia, for utility customers allocated based on usage and payable over two years following closing"

controles.affirmation: "en cas de rupture imputable a Dominion Energy, l'entreprise devrait verser 2,24 Mds $ a NextEra Energy"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Dominion Energy will be required to pay NextEra Energy a termination fee of $2.24 billion" ; et "Dominion Energy may be required to pay NextEra Energy a cash termination fee equal to $2.24 billion" (facteurs de risque)

controles.affirmation: "le plan d'investissement consolide sur 5 ans a ete releve a 65 Mds $, soit +15 Mds $ (+30%) par rapport au plan precedent"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 (D_2026-02-23) : "Its approximately $65 billion capital expenditure plan for 2026 through 2030" ; 10-K FY2024 (D_2025-02-27) : "Its approximately $50 billion capital expenditure plan for 2025 through 2029" et "In February 2025, Dominion Energy announced an updated $50.1 billion capital expenditure plan for 2025 through 2029"
controles.correction_proposee: Le chiffre est exact mais la source reelle est le 10-K FY2025, absent de _sources (l'ATF cite kpis-haut et le 10-Q, qui ne contiennent pas ce montant). Ajouter data-lake/D/10K/D_2026-02-23.htm.gz aux sources.

controles.affirmation: "le cout total du CVOW est desormais estime a 11,7 Mds $ hors financement, en hausse de 0,8 Md $ par rapport au T2 2025" ; 2,6 GW
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Installation of the final turbines comprising the 2.6 GW project is expected to be completed by the end of 2027. The estimated total project cost is approximately $11.7 billion (excluding financing costs and including $0.1 billion of contingency)" ; 10-Q T2 2025 : "The 2.6 GW project is expected to be placed in service by the end of 2026 with an estimated total project cost of approximately $10.9 billion, excluding financing costs"
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : le 10-Q decompose la variation la plus recente en -0,4 Md $ (interconnexion / PJM) et +0,4 Md $ (installation turbines) et +0,2 Md $ (tarifs Section 232), soit un depassement partiellement d'origine tarifaire et non purement operationnel. Element a charge non exploite : la mise en service a glisse de fin 2026 (10-Q T2 2025) a fin 2027.
